transcript: women test you because she needs to know that you're actually that guy. It's not some tactic or trick or something you read online. You're actually solid. You can lead. And when she recognizes that, she can turn her brain off. She can be more feminine. She can follow your lead. But until then, she's going to poke at you. She's going to see, it's like, is this just a good facade? Has this guy figured out how to present himself a certain way? Let's see what happens if I say this, or if I pull back, or if I don't message him. Let's see what he does. And she's just checking. It's like, is he in abundance? Is he actually that guy? or as he learned something online? And this is why it's so important as a man to really change yourself, not to become a good show, not to be an entertainer, but to really be solid. Transformation work, change the way you operate in reality, true confidence, true self-esteem. And that can only be done by letting go of the past, letting go of these false beliefs that have led you astray. If you're working off of insecurity and you're trying to stack confidence on top of that, you'll never get there. But if you let go of that insecurity, you'll find confidence was always under the surface.
